reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: Супер!!! Помог против агрессивного акне, правда совмещала с кремом и серумом этой же линейки, идеально, результат пришел через месяц. Приятный запах цитрусов, достаточно маленькой капли для хорошего очищения, так что хватает на долго.
reviews.zh: 超正！！！幫到手對付嚴重暗瘡，不過真係要配合埋同一系列嘅面霜同精華先用得完美，過咗一個月先見到效果。有陣好聞嘅柑橘味，每次只要一小滴就可以清潔乾淨，所以都好襟用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: I honestly didn’t have high hopes for this, but it surprised me and became my favorite morning cleanser. It pairs perfectly with my Vita C serum and morning skincare routine for a perfect glow up.
reviews.zh: 本來真係冇乜期望，但佢令我驚喜，成為咗我最鍾意嘅早晨潔面產品。配搭我支維他命C精華同早晨護膚程序，完美提亮。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite cleansers hands down. I love how it starts as a mask and then turns foamy. It cleanses deeply and it leaves my skin refreshed and bright! A must have for sure.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我最愛嘅潔面之一，毫無懸念。鍾意佢一開始係面膜質地，然後變成泡沫。深層清潔之餘，皮膚又清爽又亮白！一定必買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: BEST CLEANSER DOESNT STRIP THE SKIN BARRIER AND SOOTHS SENTIVIE SKIN AND DOES A GOOD JOB AT REMOVING MAKEUP!!
reviews.zh: 最佳潔面！唔會破壞皮膚屏障，仲可以舒緩敏感肌，落妝都卸得乾淨！！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: A little more drying than I hoped, but maybe it isn’t good for my dry winter skin. I’ll try again in the spring when my skin isn’t quite as dry.
reviews.zh: 比預期乾少少，可能唔夠適合我冬天乾燥嘅皮膚。等春天皮膚冇咁乾嗰陣再試多次。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: Un limpiador fresco y suave para usar en las mañanas cuando se quiere comenzar con el rostro fresco y limpio.
reviews.zh: 清爽溫和嘅潔面產品，適合朝早想用清爽乾淨嘅臉開始新一日嘅時候用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: I use it only one time a week because it is quite strong for my skin, removes all the impurities and leaves your skin really clean.
reviews.zh: 因為對我嚟講偏強，所以我一個星期先用一次，可以清除晒所有雜質，皮膚清得好乾淨。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Brightening All In One Cleanser 100ml
reviews.text: I tried using this multiple times, but every time after 3 or 4 days, the skin around my nasal and mouth area would become unbearably dry and red. I thought it was a change in my location as I was traveling the first few times. But I realized it's the product. I don't have extremely sensitive skin or anything, just reacted poorly to this one.
reviews.zh: 我試過用好多次，但每次用咗三、四日之後，鼻同嘴附近嘅皮膚就會乾到同紅到好難頂。頭幾次我以為係因為去咗旅行轉咗地方，但後來發覺係呢件產品嘅問題。我皮膚唔算極度敏感，只係對呢件產品反應好差。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
